t: You're facing the bronze statue of Nelson Mandela in Parliament Square, by the sculptor Ian Walters. It was unveiled on 29 August 2007. The idea was first put to Mandela by Donald Woods in 2001, and after Woods died, a fund was led by his wife and Richard Attenborough. A proposal to place it in Trafalgar Square was turned down, so it stands here. Mandela was the anti-apartheid leader who became South Africa's first black head of state, elected in a fully representative democratic election, and served as president from 1994 to 1999.
